title: Signed DNFs for depth-one circuits over gates
statement: Let $g_1,\dots,g_m \colon \{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}$ be Boolean functions, and suppose that each $g_i$ is computed both by a DNF formula of width at most $l$ and by a CNF formula of width at most $l$. Let $C_1,\dots,C_k$ be Boolean circuits on $m$ inputs, each of depth at most $1$. Then for every $j \in \{1,\dots,k\}$ there exist a DNF formula $\varphi_j$ on the $n$ variables and a sign $\varepsilon_j \in \{\mathrm{true},\mathrm{false}\}$ such that $\varphi_j$ has width at most $l$, each term of $\varphi_j$ contains every variable at most once (so no term repeats a literal or carries a variable in both polarities), and, for every assignment $x \in \{0,1\}^n$, the value $\varphi_j(x)$ when $\varepsilon_j = \mathrm{true}$ and $\lnot\varphi_j(x)$ when $\varepsilon_j = \mathrm{false}$ equals $C_j\bigl(g_1(x),\dots,g_m(x)\bigr)$.
hypotheses_covered: each circuit in the list has depth at most 1
each gate has a DNF of width at most l computing it
each gate has a CNF of width at most l computing it
replaced:
Given a list $cs$ of circuits each of depth at most $1$, over gates with width-$l$ DNF and
CNF representations, there are families $\varphi_s$ of width-$l$ DNFs (with duplicate-free,
non-repeating-variable terms) and signs indexed by $\mathrm{Fin}\,cs.\mathrm{length}$ such
that, for each index $j$, the signed evaluation of $\varphi_s\,j$ matches
$(cs.\mathrm{get}\,j).\mathrm{eval}\,(\lambda i,\ \mathrm{gates}\,i\,x)$ on every $x$.
